1.name: Salvage Arrows
1.description: Search the corpses around you, looking for arrows

1.name: Point Blank I
1.description: Fire a point-blank shot at your target, dealing 80% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 3 (L9) Physical Damage. This ability requires a bow and arrows. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

2.name: Barbed Arrow I
2.description: Fire a barbed arrow at your target, dealing 50% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 2 Bleed Damage every 6s for 18s. This ability requires a bow and arrows. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

3.name: Disengagement
3.description: Launch yourself away from your target, decreasing your Threat against them by 150 (L1) to 1500 (L60).

4.name: Skirmisher
4.description: Adopt the role of a skirmisher, increasing your Movement Speed by 10%, reducing the cooldown of Strafing Barrage by 20%, and reducing the cast time of all abilities by 20%. This ability persists until cancelled.

5.name: Illuminating Shot
5.description: Fire an illuminating shot at your target, causing them to light up for 2 minutes.

5.name: Quick Shot I
5.description: Fire a quick shot at your target, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L5) to 10 (L15) Physical Damage. Requires a bow and arrow. Shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

6.name: Net Shot
6.description: Fire a net shot at your target, interrupting their casting, knocking them back, and immobilizing them for 6 seconds. This ability has a chance to be removed by damage. This ability has a very strong chance to end early. This ability requires a bow and Net Arrow. This ability shares a cooldown with other Martial abilities.

7.name: Flare
7.description: Fire off a flare, granting you a temporary light source and revealing invisible entities. This ability requires a bow and Pitch-Wrapped Arrow.

7.name: Snaring Shot
7.description: Fire a snaring shot at your target, reducing Movement Speed by 50% for 6 seconds. This ability requires a bow and arrows. This ability has diminishing returns when used in PvE and PvP.

8.name: Interrupting Shot
8.description: Fire a sudden shot at your target, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 3 seconds. This ability requires a bow and arrows.

8.name: Strafing Barrage I
8.description: Barrage your target with arrows, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage four times. This ability can be used while moving. This ability is channeled. This ability requires a bow and arrows.

9.name: Piercing Shot I
9.description: Fire a piercing shot at your target, dealing 125% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 12 (L9) to 15 (L19) Physical Damage, and reducing incoming healing effects by 50% for 30 seconds. Additionally, if your target is below 20% Health, this ability rolls its damage twice. This ability requires a bow and arrows. This ability shares a cooldown with Splintering Shot.

10.name: Point Blank II
10.description: Fire a point-blank shot at your target, dealing 90% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 6 (L10) to 9 (L19) Physical Damage. This ability requires a bow and arrows. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

10.name: Alarm Trap
10.description: Place an alarm trap at your feet, notifying you of targets that enter the affected area.

11.name: Exposing Shot
11.description: Fire an exposing shot at your target, decreasing their Defense by 5 and increasing their Physical Damage received by 5% for 1 minute. Requires a bow and arrow. Shares a cooldown with other Martial abilities.

effects.stat: Defense by 5 and increasing their Physical Damage received

12.name: Barbed Arrow II
12.description: Fire a barbed arrow at your target, dealing 50% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 6 Bleed Damage every 6s for 20s. This ability requires a bow and arrows. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

12.name: Caltrops
12.description: Place caltrops in an area around you. Enemies who stand in the caltrops have their speed reduced by 65%.

13.name: Oil Trap I
13.description: Place an oil trap at your feet, dealing 35 fire damage to nearby Targets when detonated with Flare.

14.name: Sniper's Blind
14.description: Conceal your position, rendering you virtually undetectable. Additionally, your Quick Shot deals increased damage while concealed by Sniper's Blind. This ability is removed by movement.

15.name: Quick Shot II
15.description: Fire a quick shot at your target, dealing 125% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 10 (L15) to 20 (L25) Physical Damage. Requires a bow and arrow. Shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

16.name: Immobilizing Trap
16.description: Place a trap at your feet, immobilizing the first target that triggers it for 20 seconds.

18.name: Splintering Shot I
18.description: Fire a spreading shot at your target and those around it, dealing 50% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 3 (L18) to 4 (L28) Physical Damage. Requires a bow and arrow. Shares a cooldown with Piercing Shot and Strafing Barrage.

19.name: Piercing Shot II
19.description: Fire a piercing shot at your target, dealing 150% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 20 (L19) to 25 (L29) Physical Damage, and reducing incoming healing effects by 50% for 30 seconds. Additionally, if your target is below 20% Health, this ability rolls its damage twice. This ability requires a bow and arrows. This ability shares a cooldown with Splintering Shot.

20.name: Flurry of Arrows
20.description: Prepare yourself to unleash a flurry of arrows, instantly resetting the cooldown of your Barbed Arrow, Point Blank, and Quick Shot, and increasing your Ranged Attack Speed by 20% for 15 seconds. This ability is considered a tertiary haste. This ability resets the cooldown of Barbed Arrow, Point Blank, and Quick Shot a second time when it ends.

20.name: Point Blank III
20.description: Fire a point-blank shot at your target, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 12 (L20) to 15 (L29) Physical Damage. This ability requires a bow and arrows. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

22.name: Barbed Arrow III
22.description: Fire a barbed arrow at your target, dealing 50% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 20 Bleed Damage every 6s for 20s. This ability requires a bow and arrows. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

24.name: Marksman
24.description: Adopt the role of a marksman, increasing the damage of your Piercing Shot and Splintering Shot, and granting your ranged attacks and abilities a chance to land Critical Hits. This ability persists until cancelled.

25.name: Quick Shot III

26.name: Relocate
26.description: Retreat into the shadows and relocate to a more advantageous position, increasing your Movement Speed by 40% and rendering you virtually undetectable for 4 seconds.

28.name: Splintering Shot II
28.description: Fire a spreading shot at your target and those around it, dealing 60% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 5 (L28) to 8 (L38) Physical Damage. Requires a bow and arrow. Shares a cooldown with Piercing Shot and Strafing Barrage.

30.name: Anticipate
30.description: Anticipate enemy aggression, granting you a 100% chance to dodge incoming melee attacks for 15 seconds.

30.name: Point Blank IV
30.description: Fire a point-blank shot at your target, dealing 110% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 18 (L30) to 21 (L39) Physical Damage. This ability requires a bow and arrows. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

34.name: Smoke Bomb Arrow
34.description: Fire a smoke bomb at your target, blinding them and nearby targets for 18 seconds. This ability requires a bow and Smoke Bomb Arrow (item).
